M011.goal: I want the ADAS to adapt its forward collision avoidance behavior based on my driving intention and behavior

M013.goal: recommend mobile vaccination site placement in real-time to target under‑vaccinated populations
M013.benefit: increase vaccine uptake among hesitant groups and reduce the risk of new variants
